item.name: Abaddon
item.summary: Places Scarab Hives that periodically spawns scarabs to seek out and attack nearby enemies and beds.

item.name: Adetunde
item.summary: Start with a powerful Frost Hammer. Damaging people using the hammer has a chance to drop Frost Crystals which can be used to upgrade your hammer.

item.name: Aery
item.summary: Killing enemies adds to your collection of spirit butterflies. Each spirit butterfly amplifies sword & projectile damage. Aery's base health is reduced by 10%.

item.name: Agni
item.summary: Throw cluster bombs at your enemies and watch them go flying! Blast off with your Rocket Boost ability.

item.name: Barbarian
item.summary: Build rage by damaging enemies. Instead of buying swords, your sword is upgraded upon reaching max rage. You lose half your rage upon death. Emerald Sword is replaced by the Rageblade.

item.name: Caitlyn
item.summary: Fulfill assassination contracts to empower your attacks with a deadly decay.

item.name: Crocowolf
item.summary: Being in the vicinity of damage dealt builds bloodlust. Activate Beast Form to temporarily give you enhanced damage, knockback, and movement speed. Dealing damage to non-player entities builds more bloodlust. When your bed breaks you will be given full bloodlust.

item.name: Crypt
item.summary: Claim souls to build your undead army! Could be unlocked for FREE by completing Crypt's Trials during the Halloween 2022 event.

item.name: Eldric
item.summary: Drain health from enemies or sacrifice your health to heal allies. Could be unlocked for FREE by completing Crypt's Coven during the Halloween 2023 event.

item.name: Ember
item.summary: Charge the Blade of Fire to ignite in a deadly spin! Striking enemies OR killing Lumen will upgrade your ability to a much more powerful spin.

item.name: Evelynn
item.summary: Damage enemies to attract nearby spirits. Consume spirits to instantly teleport and gain an attack buff for a short duration.

item.name: Fortuna
item.summary: Summon cards to attack players! Deal damage to enhance your cards with different effects.

item.name: Freiya
item.summary: Dealing damage will apply stacks of Frost. At four stacks, Frost is consumed and applies Frostbite to the target, making them fragile. Emerald Sword is replaced by the Ice Sword, which applies two stacks per hit. Use your Frost Explosion ability to immediately deal damage to nearby targets with stacks of Frost.

item.name: Grim Reaper
item.summary: Consuming enemy souls grants health regen, movespeed and invulnerability for 2.5s. Combat is disabled while consuming.

item.name: Hannah
item.summary: Activate your Execute ability to defeat a nearby enemy with low health! Hannah's base health is reduced by 10%.

item.name: Isabel
item.summary: Upgrade her shield by purchasing better swords. Each upgraded shield will block more damage before breaking. The final upgrade, the Emerald Shield, will block all damage from the first hit. Shields reactivate after 30 [sic] seconds.

item.name: Kaida
item.summary: Summon a powerful dragon's claw to swipe multiple enemies at once, or summon a dragon head through a rune below you to damage all surrounding enemies. Upgrade your claw and summon attack by damaging enemies with your summon spell.

item.name: Kaliyah
item.summary: A fearsome warrior with a fiery punch!

item.name: Lassy
item.summary: Wrangle enemies towards you using a lasso.

item.name: Lian
item.summary: A mysterious warrior gifted by the dragon. Control swords to fight your enemy

item.name: Lumen
item.summary: Charge the Sword of Light to shoot powerful waves at enemies! Hitting light waves OR killing Ember will upgrade your ability to shoot many powerful beams at once.

item.name: Nazar
item.summary: Give up out-of-combat health regeneration to manipulate your life force and empower your attacks or heal. Gain life force by landing shots with life arrows and attacking.
item.specialItems: Life Headhunter Life Crossbow Life Bow

item.name: Nyx
item.summary: Trigger the darkness of Midnight to deal ramping increased damage and armor pen.

item.name: Pyro
item.summary: Use your flamethrower to spray fire, making enemies brittle, and taking more damage from attacks. Killing brittle enemies rewards ember, which you can use to upgrade your flamethrower.

item.name: Ramil
item.summary: Create sandstorms to control the battlefield, move enemies, and protect allies.

item.name: Sheep Herder
item.summary: Find and tame wild sheep around the map. Each tamed sheep amplifies your damage.

item.name: Sheila
item.summary: Start the game with an egg on your shoulder. Get kills to hatch and evolve your Seahorse, increasing its damage and unlocking passive abilities. Part of the 2022 Holiday Bundle.

item.name: Skoll
item.summary: Summon your void wolf companion Fenrir to mark an enemy. Deal extra damage to your marked target, gain a speed boost when following their trail, and see them through walls. You can detonate the mark to end the effect and deal damage.

item.name: Terra
item.summary: Stomp the ground to gather protective blocks, then kick them at your enemies. Each successful hit permanently increases kick damage!

item.name: Trixie
item.summary: Warp around and confuse your enemies with evasive combat. Every time you use Rift Warp you gain a buff that allows you to reduce Rift Warp's cooldown with melee attacks. You can also use Rift Rewind to teleport back to your last warp point.

item.name: Void Knight
item.summary: Feed your Void Corruption with resources and kills to upgrade your gear and unlock your abilities of Void Decay and Shielding. With enough resources, unlock the full power of the Void and become the Ascended Void Knight. Void Knight's base health is reduced by 10%.

item.name: Whim
item.summary: Master arcane secrets to unlock elemental powers! Spawn with a magic spellbook. Deal 20% reduced damage with swords and take 10% increased damage from all sources.
item.specialItems: Mage Spellbook Tome of the Elements

item.name: Xu'rot
item.summary: Transform into Dragon Form, unlocking a decaying dragon breath and the ability to fly. Items can't be used while in dragon form and damage scales with the highest tier sword obtained.

item.name: Zarrah
item.summary: Wields a Cutlass and Blunderbuss. Ability fires the Blunderbuss, damaging and marking enemies ahead while knocking you back. Melee hits on marked foes reset cooldown, cause bleeding, and grant a speed boost.

item.name: Archer
item.summary: Can headshot with any projectile! Deal 12.5% more projectile damage and gain access to the Tactical Crossbow in the Item Shop.

item.name: Ares
item.summary: A powerful ancient warrior that uses electric-charged throwing spears to destroy his enemies.

item.name: Bekzat
item.summary: Summon a mythical falcon to dominate an area. Work in tandem to critically strike your companion's target with your feather light bows
item.specialItems: Falcon Featherlight Headhunter Featherlight Crossbow Featherlight Bow

item.name: Frosty
item.summary: Passively create Frosted Snowballs for free. Frosted Snowballs are faster and larger.

item.name: Gompy
item.summary: Gompy the Ghost Hunter! Find ghosts around the map, vacuum them and fire them across the map.

item.name: Jack
item.summary: Lob bundles of poisonous pumpkin oil across the map.

item.name: Lyla
item.summary: Your bow is replaced with the Floral Bow! Shooting an enemy twice will bloom a flower on their head, attracting a swarm of bees!
item.specialItems: Floral Headhunter Floral Crossbow Floral Bow

item.name: Raven
item.summary: Buy ravens and fly at enemies to deliver deadly doses of poison.

item.name: Spirit Catcher
item.summary: Purchase spirits from the Item Shop and place them around the map. Spirits will chase down and explode nearby enemies.

item.name: Uma
item.summary: Summon creatures from the spirit world to assist you in combat, healing, and resource collecting!

item.name: Umeko
item.summary: Use chakrams to fight at mid-range. You can turn invisible and escape from battle if you get attacked by a melee attack.

item.name: Vanessa
item.summary: Super charge your bow to perform a triple shot.

item.name: Wizard
item.summary: Use a magical staff to cast lightning strikes and electricity orbs.

item.name: Zeno
item.summary: Use a magical staff to cast lightning spells.

item.name: Alchemist
item.summary: Use flasks to brew various potions with foraged ingredients.
item.specialItems: Alchemist Flask Mushroom Thorn Flower Sleep Splash Potion Heal Potion Poison Potion Big Shield

item.name: Axolotl Amy
item.summary: Use your pet axolotls to empower yourself and nearby teammates with shields, increased attack damage, faster break speed and health regen.

item.name: Baker
item.summary: Gain access to health-gain apples, speed-boost pies, and spawn with a knockback baguette!
item.specialItems: Health Apple Speed Pie Golden Apple Knockback Baguette

item.name: Conqueror
item.summary: Place banners to empower nearby allies.
item.specialItems: Heal Banner Defense Banner Fire Banner

item.name: Gingerbread Man
item.summary: Place gumdrops bounce pads for extreme movement. Using a gumdrop bounce pad negates all fall damage and grants a shield.

item.name: Ignis
item.summary: Use a spirit bridge to travel around the map healing your allies and providing them with armor buffs.

item.name: Lani
item.summary: An ascended healer, Lani can purchase the Scepter of Light. Use this Scepter to fly to your low health allies, providing healing and damage reduction!

item.name: Melody
item.summary: Use a guitar and the power of music to heal nearby teammates. Heal yourself for 50% [sic] of the heal given.

item.name: Nahla
item.summary: Use water veil to temporally boost the health regen of nearby allies. Purchase upgrades for your oasis vessel to strengthen your healing and buffing abilities!

item.name: Noelle
item.summary: Tame slimes to befriend your team, providing your teammates with unique buffs that strengthen over time!

item.name: Nyoka
item.summary: Charge your Mending Canopy to shine healing light on your allies.

item.name: Silas
item.summary: The leader of the citizens' rebellion, who encourages and buffs his allies with healing and damage auras!

item.name: Star Collector Stella
item.summary: Pick up floating stars around the map. Consume them while near teammates to share permanent Max Health and Critical Strike chance!

item.name: Trinity
item.summary: Ascend into an angelic form and switch freely between Light and Void. When you melee attack, Light form grants shield for you and allies, and Void form inflicts max health decay on your target.

item.name: Umbra
item.summary: Toss a hat onto other players to gain the ability to teleport to them from anywhere on the map. Ally players near the target destination are given boosted movement speed and several seconds of invulnerability while enemy players are knocked back and briefly slowed.

item.name: Whisper
item.summary: Control a Spirit Owl to support ally players. Unlocked at Player Level 10.

item.name: Zola
item.summary: Connect enemies with soul links! Damage dealt to linked enemies incurs bonus damage to any other linked enemies. Allies can also be linked, allowing you to take damage in their place.

item.name: Beekeeper Beatrix
item.summary: Catch bees around the map to upgrade your Bee Hive. Upgrading your Bee Hive will return additional iron and emeralds.

item.name: Bounty Hunter
item.summary: Get assigned bounties for killing certain players in the match. Completing a bounty rewards a random amount of resources.

item.name: Cogsworth
item.summary: Deploy robots that search for generators and collect resources!

item.name: Cyber
item.summary: Deploy and control drones to pickup resources from around the map. Drones can also airdrop primed TNT.

item.name: Drill
item.summary: Purchase Drills to deploy on Diamond and Emerald generators. Drills automatically harvest 2x gen resources. Control them to fight off attackers.

item.name: Farmer Cletus
item.summary: Invest your resources into crops that yield more diamonds and emeralds.
item.specialItems: Melon Seeds Carrot Seeds Pumpkin Seeds

item.name: Fisherman
item.summary: Why fight when you can fish?
item.specialItems: Fishing Rod Coral Block Charge Shield Rocket Launcher

item.name: Grove
item.summary: Purchase seeds and grow them into flowers that buff allies and enhance generator production. Keep your flowers alive by providing them with spirit energy gathered around the map to prevent them from withering.
item.specialItems: Crystalheart Seed Soulvine Seed Tearbloom Seed

item.name: Lucía
item.summary: Use the candy you get from damaging players to fill up your piñata. When you're ready, smash it for lots of loot!

item.name: Merchant Marco
item.summary: Get resources back on certain item shop purchases! This refund is randomized each game!

item.name: Metal Detector
item.summary: Use a Metal Detector to find treasure around the map.

item.name: Milo
item.summary: Disguise as a block and pickpocket from other players!

item.name: Miner
item.summary: Killing enemies turns them into stone. The Miner can break down the stone for valuables[sic] resources (scaled by the price of enemy's armor + sword). Unable to purchase Axes.

item.name: Taliyah
item.summary: Buy eggs & hatch them into chickens! Chickens can either be sold back to the merchant or deployed in combat!

item.name: Wren
item.summary: Summon a secret black market offering powerful potions and random deals. Earn a cut from every sale, and use shadow coins gathered from fallen players to upgrade your shop.
item.specialItems: Fury Potion Serpent's Touch Shadow Coin

item.name: Zenith
item.summary: Deploy a satellite to disrupt enemy team economies. Enemy shop prices are increased and you get a cut of each purchase!

item.name: Builder
item.summary: Fortify blocks with extra health and blast protection using the Builder's hammer. Purchase the Hammer from the Item Shop.

item.name: Marcel
item.summary: Use your Defense Scanner to instantly purchase blocks in the Defense Schematic shown around your team's bed. Can place two Tesla Traps.

item.name: Marina
item.summary: Deploy jellyfish and electrify them with your Electric Pulse ability, causing them to zap nearby enemies. Connect jellyfish to increase the range and power of your ability.

item.name: Trapper
item.summary: Place Snap Traps to stun unexpecting enemies, Damaging a recently trapped enemy will consume a mark dealing extra damage.

item.name: Vulcan
item.summary: Use a high tech tablet to control camera turrets across the map. While holding the tablet, mark enemies or link to your turrets' view.

item.name: Death Adder
item.summary: Charge up explosive comets to rain destruction on your enemy's base. Collect alchemy crystals to unlock even stronger abilities!

item.name: Dino Tamer Dom
item.summary: Can purchase a Dino mount. Charge into defenses to knock them down!

item.name: Pirate Davey
item.summary: Use a TNT Cannon to bombard your enemies.

item.name: Ragnar
item.summary: Use your Berserker Rage ability to increase break speed, reduce incoming damage and prevent incoming knockback to rush in on an enemy's bed defense.

item.name: Santa
item.summary: Play as Santa and call in high-explosive sleigh strafe runs!

item.name: Smoke
item.summary: A stealth-focused kit that uses smoke charges to grant invisibility.

item.name: Warden
item.summary: Imprison the souls of recently killed enemies to increase their respawn time. For each actively imprisoned soul you gain Break Speed and Shield Regeneration.

item.name: Yeti
item.summary: Let out a Glacier Roar to temporarily freeze nearby blocks. Frozen blocks can be destroyed extremely fast.

item.name: Cobalt
item.summary: Every time you take damage you have a chance of dropping a battery on the ground. Once the battery activates you can pick it up for a small shield. After collecting 3 batteries you will overload, gaining movement speed and damage!

item.name: Eldertree
item.summary: Collect tree orbs around the map to increase size and max HP. Cannot buy armor.

item.name: Hephaestus
item.summary: Upgrade your Talos Mech to increase shield and damage! Activate Self-Destruct to deal massive damage.

item.name: Infernal Shielder
item.summary: Spawn with a massive shield. Gain energy while holding your shield, and raise your shield to deflect incoming projectiles.

item.name: Martin
item.summary: Absorb life essence from nearby enemies and convert it to max hp! Attack is slower but passively reflects damage for melee hits to the enemy.

item.name: Warrior
item.summary: Gain grit in battle and can keep fighting after taken fatal damage.

item.name: Arachne
item.summary: The Spider Queen uses web bridges to traverse the map and can summon spiderlings from her webs to attack enemies. Enemies are slowed if they run into her webs.

item.name: Elektra
item.summary: Dash through players to deal electric damage! Hold up to two stacks of dashes and regain all stacks if you kill an enemy with your dash.

item.name: Flora
item.summary: Use explosive beehives to deal high damage to your enemies or throw them at yourself for a massive launch.

item.name: Jade
item.summary: Launch into the air with a giant war hammer. Higher launches deal more slam damage, and the hammer can be upgraded throughout the match.

item.name: Krystal
item.summary: Keep moving (especially on frozen blocks!) to increase your momentum and movement speed. At high momentum, trigger jumps to dodge. Part of the 2024 Holiday Bundle.

item.name: Marrow
item.summary: Defy death and hop around as a skull after taking mortal damage. Survive long enough in this form and you will revive! Use your ability to create poison clouds that damage and slow enemies (this ability also triggers while in skull form).

item.name: Sigrid
item.summary: Summon your mount, charge at your enemies and send them flying! Cannot use weapons while riding the Elk. Part of the 2023 Holiday Bundle.

item.name: Sophia
item.summary: Use a Frost Staff to slow and freeze enemies!

item.name: Styx
item.summary: Connect your Confluence Portal to a slain enemy to teleport you and your allies to that location.

item.name: Triton
item.summary: An agile warrior with a Trident! Hurl your trident towards a wall, or your opponents, to quickly travel and dominate the battlefield.

item.name: Void Regent
item.summary: Use a Void Axe to dash forward while slashing at enemies, healing for a portion of the damage dealt. (Part of the Holiday 2021 Bundle).

item.name: Yamini
item.summary: Climb and pounce with feline dexterity! Fall damage is reduced since you always land on your feet.

item.name: Yuzi
item.summary: Swords are replaced by traditional Dao Swords. Hold attack to execute a forward dash AOE attack.

item.name: Zephyr
item.summary: Killing enemies gives you a stack of wind, decaying a short while after. Each stack of wind gives you more speed and adds a second wind strike to your attack. At 5 stacks you can triple jump!
